decode.scene_logic: no scene — a product grid; ours is the same grid with the three things she already tried against her swollen legs: water-tablet diuretics, herbal drainage drops, Edenvia
decode.visual_trick: the glowing gold third column and the red→orange→green result words; copy literally (gold frame on the Edenvia column, result words in the same red / orange / green)
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: three supplement bottles ↔ a diuretic bottle, a dropper bottle of herbal drops, the Edenvia pouch (pouch keeps real proportions, same height as the rivals)
decode.structure_type: table (3 columns × 5 attribute rows + result row + rating row)
decode.render_style: dark navy flat layout, white serif headline, bold sans body, pasted product photos with soft drop shadow
decode.text_treatment: bold sans labels in white, attribute names in bold, verdict words large in red / orange / green, gold frame on the winner, bottom banner strip

strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: tried diuretics, teas and drops, swelling always came back · cause: inflamed tissue holding fluid · tried: dieting harder, water tablets, herbal drops, compression
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.
